he [roadway] [roadway]. unit 1 stated that while he was driving he did not see unit 2 or unit 3 [roadway]. unit 1 stated he heard unit 3 hit his drivers side mirror then shortly after he heard a loud thump coming from the front of his truck but did not see unit 2. unit 1 stated that he stopped the vehicle and immediately called 9-1-1. after speaking with the driver of unit 1, i went to see unit 3 who was also being treated by ems and was unable to give a statement as to what had happened. unit [medical facility] by ems and were in the custody of officer brown #0197. unit 3 sustained a right broken arm. unit 2 was unresponsive and sustained multiple injuries. i spoke with w1, w1 stated she [roadway] [roadway] and was behind unit 1. w1 stated she saw unit 2 and unit 3 [roadway] in dark limit down the roadway. i then spoke with w2 who [roadway] [roadway] when he heard screaming coming from unit 3. w2 stated he saw unit 1 hit unit 3 with the driver's side door mirror and heard the vehicle screech. i spoke with w3 who was the mother of unit 2. w3 stated she was pulled over waiting for unit 2 and unit 3 across the roadway in the [roadway] when she heard screaming coming from the 1's vehicle. unit 1's vehicle was towed by texas tow and was towed to growdon. unit 1 had damage on the front right side and a broken right mirror. the scene was then cleared with no further incident. records.deidentified_narrative: on [date] at about 1215 hours i was flagged down in palo alto college lot #1 by a serena martinez who wanted to report someone struck her vehicle. martinez also stated saul zavala witnessed the accident and had a picture of the unknown female who hit her car. i spoke with zavala who stated that he witnessed a blue mitsubishi lancer hit martinez's mitsubishi mirage(red/wine) as it attempted to park in a parking space next to it. zavala added that the lancer hit the mirage's passenger rear bumper and tire. zavala added that he then saw [roadway] to another part of lot # 1 to park. zavala added that he observed a hispanic female exit the lancer and approach the mirage to look at the damage. zavala said he to a photo of the female and showed it to me. (the photo was emailed too my district address and added to the report.) zavala stated that the accident occurred at about 1156 hours. i collected zavala's information and he departed. as i was speaking with zavala, sgt. martinez arrived and found the lancer that zavala pointed out. i then collected martinez's information and took photos of the damage. martinez added that the mirage was owned by her father alex martinez and she needed to speak with him before deciding to press charges. martinez was not present at time of crash. i then proceeded to the lancer and collected information and found red/wine paint transfer on the front passenger side bumper. i had dispatch run the lancer([identifier]) and it came back to a registered owner andrea irene leal. i took pictures of the damage and left a case card on the lancer's front window requesting the driver contact campus police. on [date] sgt. martinez he spoke with the driver of the blue lancer on [date]. sgt. martinez told me that the driver of the lancer was araceli gonzales and provided me the dl and insurance information. gonzales explained she had just gotten her driver's license this past year and was scared and did not know what to do. end of report.

records.deidentified_narrative: on january 19th, 2023, at approximately 6:25 am, a motor vehicle pedestrian fatality crash occurred on us 277 near mile marker 602 in maverick county, texas. the crash involved a black 2007 dodge and pedestrian. at the time of the crash, the 2007 dodge was traveling south on us 277 during the hours of darkness with light traffic. the pedestrian was positioned at an unknown exact location on the western side of the us 277, off the ordinarily traveled portion of the roadway. the pedestrian entered the roadway when it was unsafe to do so by failing to yield the right of way to an approaching motor vehicle. the 2007 dodges front right collided with [roadway] of us 277. the pedestrian succumbed to injuries sustained from the crash on scene. the driver of the 2007 dodge, and sole occupant, sustained no injuries from the crash. upon speaking with the driver, no objective signs or symptoms of alcohol intoxication were noted. furthermore, the driver displayed no signs of a physical or mental condition which would question their operation of a motor vehicle.
